name: JEEVAN NEDUNCHEZHIYAN
bio:
Career Overview: Jeevan Nedunchezhiyan is an Indian professional tennis player renowned for his doubles prowess, competing on the ATP Tour and representing India internationally.
Playing Style: A versatile doubles player with a strong baseline game and effective net play, excelling on hard courts with a powerful serve.
Career-High ATP Singles Ranking: #293 (August 25, 2014), Career-High ATP Doubles Ranking: #64 (March 18, 2019).
Best Grand Slam Singles Performance: Limited singles participation, mostly in lower-tier events.
Grand Slam Achievements: Reached the second round in men’s doubles at the Australian Open (2017, 2023) and Wimbledon (2019).
Notable Achievements: ATP Titles: Won 2 ATP doubles titles: 2017 Chennai Open with Rohan Bopanna and 2023 Maharashtra Open with Sriram Balaji. Davis Cup & National Representation: Represented India in Davis Cup ties since 2017, contributing to team efforts. Challenger Success: Secured 22 ATP Challenger doubles titles, showcasing consistency at that level.
Other Highlights: Known for partnerships with top Indian players like Rohan Bopanna and Sriram Balaji. A product of Tamil Nadu’s tennis ecosystem, Jeevan continues to be a key figure in Indian doubles tennis. 🎾🇮🇳
